brief:
Greece is scheduled to sign a $3.6 billion defense agreement with Israel on Monday, according to Shehab Wire. The comprehensive deal encompasses the establishment of a multi-layered air and missile defense system designed to bolster Greece's aerial defense infrastructure. The agreement represents one of the largest weapons export transactions in Israeli history.

The contract reflects growing defense cooperation between Athens and Tel Aviv as Greece seeks to modernize its air defense capabilities. The multi-layered system will integrate advanced technologies to address regional security threats and enhance Greece's strategic defense posture in the Eastern Mediterranean.
